hero.role: Senior Full Stack Developer · Industrial Engineer · AI & Software Automation
hero.description1: Industrial Engineer and Senior Full Stack Developer with more than 10 years of experience building web applications, REST APIs, mobile solutions and enterprise software.
hero.description2: Specialized in .NET, C#, React, TypeScript, SQL Server, MongoDB and modern Full Stack architectures. Passionate about software engineering, automation, artificial intelligence and continuous learning.

about.title: About
about.paragraph1: I started my professional career as an Industrial Engineer, working on projects related to energy efficiency, electrical systems, climate control and industrial installations.
about.paragraph2: During those years, software development was initially a personal passion. Over time, that passion became my main profession and eventually led me to transition completely into software engineering.
about.paragraph3: Today I work as a Senior .NET Full Stack Developer, participating in the analysis, design, development and maintenance of enterprise applications, REST APIs, web platforms and mobile solutions.
about.paragraph4: My main technologies include C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, React, TypeScript, SQL Server, MongoDB, Razor, Blazor, Unity and modern Full Stack architectures.
about.paragraph5: Since 2023 I have incorporated Artificial Intelligence tools such as ChatGPT and Claude into real software development workflows.
